title: Debt and Border
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Halloran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
